title: Daniel Podaru
requirements: An extended, multi-phase technical engagement supporting a custom-branded main character avatar. Work spanned from creating the original protagonist sculpt to correcting severe skeletal distortion anomalies caused by auto-mapping tools. The final phase involved upgrading the character with custom rigging for lips, chin, and nose expressions and resolving material bleeding on in-game glasses.
achievements: Upgraded a simple character framework to a performance-ready facial animation rig
Resolved skin shader bleed and texture boundary overlaps through meticulous coordinate corrections
Maintained professional communication and delivered key iterations under difficult project circumstances
